jobs.description: Job DescriptionAbout the jobAs Business Product Manager you will maximize revenue and profitability of an existing family or families of products within a Product Group’s portfolio. You own the Pricing and Go to Market (G2M) strategy for running portfolios.The role requires profound knowledge and experience in pricing strategies, channel management and negotiation. Furthermore, a strong ability to manage a complex network of internal and external stakeholders, including customers is required.What you will do- Drive revenue and profitability of the assigned product segment by being hungry and willing to win in a challenging and dynamic business environment- Be the business partner for Business Group (BG) Marketing and Global Sales & Marketing (GSM) in the assigned product portfolio (manufacturing strategy, benefits, longevity etc.)- Develop key customer & channel strategies together with Product Group Head, Business Marketing Managers, Product Marketing Managers and GSM- Own the pricing tactics and quote policies for all sales channels for Commercial Marketing in alignment with Product Marketing Managers, Business Marketing Managers and in line with overall Product Group target settings- Build & maintain G2M material- Competitor analysis: consolidate input from regions about competitor behaviors, especially pricing strategy at Distribution and OEM channel, inputting (to Industrial) for required cost down roadmaps to reach Product Group margin targets- Forecasting: align with Demand Management in line with forecast process- Manage pricing strategy, price setting and special offers for business via Distribution partners- Drive design-in/design-win success through organizing necessary support to BG Marketing and GSM- Establish and maintain relationships with key customers and partners in alignment with BG Marketing and GSM.What you will need- University degree in electrical and electronic engineering or other related discipline- Min. 5 years’ experience in Product Marketing or Product Management in the Semiconductor industry- Proven track record of product (lifecycle) management, with strong understanding of market trends and customer needs, preferably with exposure to international customers- Strong individual accountability, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively- Ability to establish lasting relationships and networks in a complex environment across different levels of hierarchies and various stakeholders in a multiple culture environment- Direct work experience with Power semiconductors or previous experience in product line is preferred- Knowledge of key business metrics and strong negotiation skills- Business fluent in English (written and spoken), any other language is a plus- Willingness to travel occasionallyWhy work for us? - Flexible working hours and possibility of overtime reduction to maintain a Work-Life-Balance - Unlimited employment contract with a competitive salary and supplementary voluntary employee benefits - A wide variety of training courses and career development options - Numerous further benefits, such as retirement provisions, travel allowance for the public transport ticket, company events, sports and leisure activities, employee discounts and even more Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. Nexperia job adverts are Nexperia copyright © material and the word Nexperia® is a registered trademark.D&I StatementAs an equal-opportunity employer, Nexperia values diversity not just because it is the right thing to do but because diverse teams perform better. We are dedicated to being inclusive, and a proof point of this dedication is that we were the main partner of the very first Dutch Paralympic Team NL House during the Paris 2024 Paralympic Games. Our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all, and we consider all applicants fairly, as well as providing a safe work environment and reasonable adjustments where requested.In addition, we offer our colleagues the possibility to join employee resource groups such as the Pride Network Group or global and local Women's groups. Nexperia is committed to increasing women in management positions to 30% by 2030.

About NexperiaAt Nexperia, legal expertise is a key enabler of our global business strategy. As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.About the roleIn this senior role you:- Provide corporate legal support and ensure corporate compliance for the global Nexperia group, including Nexperia Germany and the Hamburg site (which includes corporate housekeeping and ESG).- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.- Support the Deputy Chief Legal Officer ("DCLO") on specific matters in strategic corporate projects, such as in the field of Corporate/M&A, Finance, Tax and Treasury (which includes M&A, investments, strategic co-operations (incl R&D), intercompany agreements, treasury and insurance matters).- Deliver commercial legal support to certain key customers under the supervision of the DCLO.- Are managing disputes, litigation and claims (such as distributors, local suppliers etc).- Are managing outside legal counsel and legal spend.- Support the German Corporate Affairs department.The role is based at our office in Hamburg, and you will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer.What you will needThe ideal candidate has 6-10 years of relevant experience as a corporate lawyer or (in-house) legal counsel and is ready to further apply and deepen their expertise in an international environment.Furthermore, you have:- A completed university degree in law.- A truly international mindset and have excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).- Strong knowledge of and experience in corporate law and ESG in an international setting.- Relevant experience gained at a leading law firm and/or a multinational company (considered as an advantage).- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.- Litigation experience (considered an advantage).- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.

About the jobTo strengthen our R&D organization, we are looking for an Automation & AI Specialist (m/f/d) who translates business requirements into scalable automation and AI supported solutions and actively contributes to improving the efficiency of our R&D processes. You will be directly involved in shaping the digitalization, automation, and AI enablement of R&D processes in an international, technology driven environment.What you will do- Translate R&D business and user requirements into effective system, process, and automation solutions- Design, implement, test, and continuously improve automated workflows, AI-augmented data flows and AI Agents- Ensure stable data flows, high data quality, and reliable system operations- Operate and further develop R&D collaboration and workflow tools (e.g. SharePoint, monday.com, SwiftKanban), including hands on application support- Actively support change adoption through structured onboarding, release communication and user enablement- Work closely with Nexperia IT, internal stakeholders, and external partnersWhat you will need- University degree in business administration, computer science, engineering, or a comparable technical discipline- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a comparable position, depending on educational credentials- Strong understanding of business process and R&D process automation- Practical experience with scripting languages (e.g. Python, VBA); deeper software development skills are a plus- Knowledge of data integration and data exchange, e.g. between SAP applications and other systems- Hands on experience with collaboration and workflow tools such as SharePoint, monday.com, or comparable platforms- Strong communication and networking skills and proficiency in German and English (written and spoken)- Structured, solution oriented working style with a strong focus on quality- Service oriented, reliable team player with a high level of flexibility combined with accountability and commitment.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Forschung, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Projektmanagement

At the same time, we are open to individual part-time arrangements, provided they are compatible with the requirements of the role. With flexible working hours, mobile working, and sabbaticals, we will find a working model that suits your individual needs.- Time off that truly matters: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation per year.- Secure your future: With our company pension plan, we already invest today in your financial security of tomorrow.- Career with perspective: We actively support you in shaping your career through individual trainings, access to learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning, and a wide range of development opportunities.- Borderless opportunities: As an EU citizen, you can work remote from other EU countries for up to 40 days per year – offering greater freedom and international flexibility.- Exclusive employee benefits: Take advantage of attractive discounts and a wide range of employee benefits.- Stay fit – nationwide: With our comprehensive range of health and wellness initiatives, you stay active – wherever you are in Germany.- Sustainable mobility: Use our “JobRad” bike leasing program and secure your preferred bicycle at attractive conditions – for more fitness, climate protection, and enjoyment on your daily commute.- A family-friendly culture: We support you with various offers that help balance work and family life, such as on-site childcare places and free emergency childcare services.- Support when it matters most: The Fürstenberg Institute provides you with a confidential external point of contact for professional advice and support in both personal and professional matters.- A work environment that embraces diversity: Look forward to working in a diverse and international environment through collaboration with our global locations.For more information about the employee benefits you can expect at Continental, please visit our benefits page (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/benefits/) . If you would like to learn more about our location, feel free to visit our site page: Hannover Corporate Headquarters (https://www.continental.com/de/karriere/arbeiten-bei-continental/standorte/continental-unternehmenszentrale/) .Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/corporate-culture-values/diversity/) are important to us and make our company strong and successful. jobs.description: About the roleJoin us as our Team Lead Technical Operations and help shape the reliability, resilience, and future of DIGITEC’s SaaS operations!DIGITEC is a leading provider of Foreign Exchange SaaS solutions, specializing in FX Swaps, NDFs, and Money Markets. We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Team Lead Technical Operations to lead our TechOps team and ensure the reliable, secure, resilient, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.In this role, you will combine technical leadership, people development, and operational ownership, leading a multinational TechOps team of four people based across Hamburg, London, and Singapore. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will play a key role in evolving our operations from manual and infrastructure-centric processes toward a more automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native environment, applying SRE and Operational Excellence principles.You will work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to continuously improve how we operate our platforms and deliver reliable services to our clients.Your ResponsibilitiesTechnical Operations & Reliability- Lead the reliable, resilient, secure, and scalable operation of our D3 SaaS platforms.- Drive service reliability using SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, and reliability engineering.- Oversee incident, problem, and escalation management while strengthening Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and technical resilience.Operational Excellence & Transformation- Drive the evolution toward automated, standardized, observable, and cloud-native operations.- Continuously improve operational processes, tooling, automation, and KPIs to increase reliability and efficiency.- Promote a culture of Operational Excellence, continuous improvement, and effective problem management.Team Leadership & Collaboration- Lead and develop our multinational TechOps team across Hamburg, London, and Singapore, fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.- Provide technical and operational direction while remaining hands-on where needed.- Work closely with DevOps, Development, Security, Product, and Service Delivery to align priorities, solve operational challenges, and continuously improve our services.Preferred qualifications- Several years of experience operating business-critical SaaS and cloud applications, combined with proven leadership experience in technical teams.- Strong hands-on experience with SRE and Operational Excellence, including observability, SLIs/SLOs, automation, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement.- Solid experience with incident, problem, and escalation management in production environments.- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, networking, operating systems, and containerization.- Good knowledge of Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, technical resilience, and security principles relevant to SaaS operations.- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.- A hands-on and proactive mindset, with the willingness to understand the technical details of our D3 product family.- Fluent English skills.Nice to haveExperience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:- ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.- Experience with AIOps, operational automation, or cloud-native transformation.- Experience working in regulated environments, ideally financial services.- German language skills.What we offer as an employer- Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.- Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.- Be part of an international work force: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.- Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.- Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.- Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.Our commitment to inclusion:We welcome applications from people of all ages, backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, gender identities, religions and sexual orientations, as well as from disabled and neurodivergent people and people living with chronic conditions.Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about what you can bring than about a perfect match.If anything in our application or interview process could be more accessible for you, just let us know. You don’t need to tell us why, and it won’t affect your application*.*Ergänzende Informationen:Nur schwerbehinderte oder ihnen gleichgestellte PersonenHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Zwingend erforderlich: Customer-Relationship-Management (CRM), Anwendungstechnik, Anwendungsberatung, Kundenberatung, -betreuung

jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Position title:

Deutsch

Globaler Business Process Experte (m/w/d) – R2R – Intercompany Accounting -Services

English

global Business Process Expert– R2R – Intercompany Accounting -Services

Berichtet an / Reporting to:

BPO-R2R-SL

Abteilung / Department:

GES – Functional Solution Accounting and Finance – R2R Subledger | EF-DS-GSFS

Arbeitgeber / Arbeitsort /
Company, Place of Work:

Merck KGaA, Darmstadt

Land / Country:

Deutschland / Germany

DETAILLIERTE STELLENBESCHREIBUNG / SPECIFIC JOB DESCRIPTION

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

Key Accountabilities:

Ziel der Position:

·          Diese Position spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Steuerung und Optimierung des End-to-End-Prozesses in der Buchhaltung von innerkonzernlichen Verrechnungen von Services, immateriellen Dienstleistungen, dem Verkauf von Bestandteilen des Anlagevermögens sowie dem Ausgleich anderer nicht zum Umlaufvermögen gehörender Rechte und Pflichten (Dividenden, Patentgebühren, Transferpreisanpassungen, etc.) besser bekannt als „Intercompany Accounting- Service“

·          Sie treibt globale, strukturelle Prozessverbesserungen, Standardisierung sowie Automatisierung voran – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Innovations- und Analytics-Team sowie den Fachbereichen und unterstützenden Funktionen

·          Aufbau zentraler Fähigkeiten innerhalb von GES zu Unterstützung der Unternehmensstrategie und Transformationsinitiativen

Übergeordneter Prozessumfang:

- Gesamtverantwortung für die Prozessoptimierung und Abstimmungsprozesse (Reconciliation), Transformationsinitiativen sowie strategische und geschäftskritische Programme (z. B. ERP).
- Kontinuierliche Bewertung und Verbesserung des End-to-End-Intercompany Accounting -Services mit Fokus auf Automatisierung, Standardisierung und Effizienzsteigerung.
- Implementierung und Unterstützung der Ressourcenplanung.

Geschäftsprozesse (Business Process):

- Definition, Design, Architektur und Implementierung eines globalen End-to-End-Prozessmodells zur Optimierung der Abläufe über alle Organisationseinheiten hinweg (innerhalb und außerhalb von GES).
- örderung von Prozessvereinfachung, Standardisierung/Modularisierung und Automatisierung in enger Abstimmung mit operativen Einheiten, Fachbereichen und unterstützenden Funktionen.
- Steuerung und Sicherstellung geeigneter Prozesse für Business- und Supportfunktionen.
- Identifikation und Implementierung von Best Practices (intern und extern).
- Verantwortung für Tools, Anwendungen, Systeme, Richtlinien und Prozessdesign in enger Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
- Definition und Umsetzung einer Prozess-Governance gemeinsam mit dem BPM-Team, einschließlich: Change-Control-Prozessen, Compliance-Sicherstellung. Dokumentation und Pflege
- Definition von Kontroll- und Risikopunkten sowie Nachverfolgung von Audits
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data-Team zur Sicherstellung von Data Governance.

Strategische Initiativen :

- Verantwortung für strategische Initiativen wie ERP-Einführung, Implementierung und Automatisierungsprogramme, sowie Periphere-Lösungen (z.b. Workflows) .
- Leitung von Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen unter Nutzung moderner Technologien und Best Practices zur Effizienzsteigerung.

Performance Management :

- Definition, Steuerung und Pflege von KPIs zur Messung der operativen Performance und Prozessstandardisierung.
- Förderung der Automatisierung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung relevanter Reporting-Tools.
- Internes und externes Benchmarking der KPIs.
- Definition und Steuerung von SLAs zu den der operativen Einheiten erbrachten Leistungen des Buchhaltung für die innerkonzernliche Verrechnungen in globaler Abstimmung mit relevanten Stakeholdern.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Nutzererlebnis und Effektivität entlang des End-to-End-Prozesses.

Erweiterung:

- Verantwortung für die Erweiterung des Leistungsumfangs (horizontal und vertikal), um zusätzliche Services für Business- und Supportfunktionen bereitzustellen

Kompetenzen und Fähigkeiten

- Aufbau kritischer Kompetenzen im Value-Stream-Team zur Identifikation, Priorisierung, Lösungsentwicklung und Steuerung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.
- Abstimmung mit operativen Führungskräften im R2R-Bereich zur Entwicklung von Lernpfaden für Fach-Expert: innen (SMEs).
- Aufbau von Lern- und Austauschplattformen je Teilprozess zur Förderung von Best Practices und Wissensaustausch.
- Förderung eines virtuellen Prozessnetzwerks zur Steigerung von Qualität und Produktivität.

Organisatorische Einbindung

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Delivery-Teams und deren Leitungen in Hubs und/oder Service Centern.
- Schnittstellenfunktion (dotted-line) zwischen funktionalen Führungskräften im R2R-Subledger-Bereich und dem BPO R2R-SL.

Purpose of the role:

·          This role plays a critical part in managing and optimizing the end-to-end process in accounting for intercompany transactions, including services, intangible services, the sale of services within MERCK, and the settlement of other rights and obligations (dividends, patent royalties, transfer price adjustments, etc.), commonly known as "Intercompany Accounting Services."

·          Drives global structural process improvements, standardization, and automation in close collaboration with the Innovation and Analytics team, business units, and support functions.

·          Establishes core capabilities within GES to support enterprise strategy and transformation initiatives.

High level Process Scope:

- End-to-end accountability for process optimization, reconciliation activities, transformation initiatives, and strategic business-critical programs (e.g., ERP).
- Continuous assessment and enhancement of the end-to-end Intercompany Accounting Services with focus on automation, standardization, and efficiency improvements.
- Implementation and support of resource planning initiatives.

Business Process:

- Definition, design, architecture, and implementation of a global end-to-end process model to optimize operations across all organizational units (within and outside GES).
- Promotion of process simplification, standardization/modularization, and automation in close alignment with operational units, business units, and support functions.
- Management and assurance of appropriate processes for business and support functions.
- Identification and implementation of internal and external best practices.
- Ownership of tools, applications, systems, policies, and process design in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
- Definition and execution of process governance in collaboration with the BPM team, including: Change control processes, Compliance assurance, Documentation and maintenance, Definition of control and risk points and audit tracking
- Close collaboration with the Data team to ensure data governance.

Strategic initiatives :

- Accountability for strategic initiatives such as ERP implementation, automation programs, and peripheral solutions (e.g., workflows).
- Leadership of process improvement initiatives leveraging modern technologies and best practices to drive efficiency gains.

- Definition, management, and maintenance of KPIs to measure operational performance and process standardization.
- Promotion of automation and continuous enhancement of relevant reporting tools.
- Internal and external KPI benchmarking.
- Definition and management of SLAs for Intercompany Accounting Services delivered by operational units in global alignment with relevant stakeholders.
- Enhancement of quality, user experience, and effectiveness across the end-to-end process.

Scope expansion:.

- Own the scope extension and penetration both vertically and horizontally to deliver further services covers to the business and enabling functions

Capability building :

- Build critical competencies within the value-stream team to identify, prioritize, develop solutions, and drive improvement measures.
- Alignment with operational leaders in the R2R area to develop learning pathways for subject matter experts (SMEs).
- Establishment of learning and knowledge-sharing platforms by sub-process to promote best practices and knowledge exchange.
- Fostering a virtual process network to enhance quality and productiv(...)
